title: AbsoluteDegradation: A Physics-Inspired Synthetic Film-Degradation Pipeline and Archival Film Restoration Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2607.02131v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Restoring archival film remains a fundamentally challenging problem due to the absence of paired training data and the lack of standardized evaluation benchmarks. Pristine versions of deteriorated footage are physically unrecoverable, requiring supervised methods to rely on synthetic data that often fail to capture the complex, temporally coherent nature of real film degradation. At the same time, existing real-world datasets are limited in scale, quality, and accessibility, hindering reliable evaluation and fair comparison across methods. We address both limitations with AbsoluteDegradation, a physics-inspired, modular pipeline for synthesizing realistic film degradations, and a new large-scale archival benchmark. The proposed pipeline models the analog-to-digital process as a structured composition of artifact families, incorporating signal-dependent grain, parametric scratches, and temporally coherent camera motion, enabling

translated_title: AbsoluteDegradation：一个受物理启发的合成胶片退化流水线与档案胶片修复基准
translated_abstract: 由于缺乏成对的训练数据以及标准化的评估基准，档案胶片修复仍然是一个根本性的挑战性问题。受损影像的完好版本在物理上是无法恢复的，这使得有监督方法不得不依赖合成数据，而这些合成数据往往无法捕捉真实胶片退化中复杂且具有时间连贯性的特性。与此同时，现有的真实世界数据集在规模、质量和可获取性方面都很有限，阻碍了可靠的评估以及不同方法之间的公平比较。我们通过 AbsoluteDegradation 来解决这两个局限性——这是一个受物理启发、模块化的真实胶片退化合成流水线，同时我们还构建了一个新的大规模档案胶片基准。所提出的流水线将模拟到数字的过程建模为一系列伪影族的结构化组合，包含信号相关的颗粒噪声、参数化的划痕以及时间连贯的摄像机运动，从而……
tldr: 提出了受物理启发的模块化胶片退化合成流水线AbsoluteDegradation及新的大规模档案胶片修复基准，以解决档案胶片修复中缺乏成对训练数据和标准化评估基准的双重难题。
